# optionledger.flex_fetch r2

optionledger.flex_fetch r2: one record per request pair of the daily job (one window of one query of one login) or per file of the web import, with its outcome and counts; insert only. For an import record, ok means the file was read, also when nothing was found and when the account is not configured; first_date and last_date are the period of the alias's statements, else its trade dates, else the day of the request. No token and no account number is stored.

| column | type | nullable | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| fetch_id | string | no | Identifier of the fetch. |
| login | string | no | Name of the login of flex.toml; import names the web import. |
| query_id | string | no | Flex query id as text: digits for a window of the daily job; file:<request id>:<ordinal>:<alias> for a file of the web import. |
| first_date | string (date) | no | First day of the window; for an import record the first day of the period of the alias's statements, else of its trade dates, else the day of the request. |
| last_date | string (date) | no | Last day of the window; for an import record the last day of the period of the alias's statements, else of its trade dates, else the day of the request. |
| started_at | string (date-time) | no | Instant the request pair started, UTC. |
| finished_at | string (date-time) | no | Instant the request pair finished, UTC. |
| status | enum(ok, failed) | no | ok: the report was parsed and stored, or for an import record the file was read (also nothing found and account not configured); failed: the window or file failed and nothing but this record was stored. |
| error_kind | string | no | Kind of the error when failed, for example network or flex_error; empty when ok. |
| error_code | string | no | Flex error code as text when the service gave one; empty otherwise. |
| raw_sha256 | string | no | SHA-256 of the report, 64 lower-case hex digits; empty when no report arrived. The report itself is not kept. |
| parser_version | string | no | Version of the report parser. |
| statements | integer | no | Number of statements in the report. |
| statements_unmapped | integer | no | Statements of an account the allow-list does not map; not stored. |
| rows_parsed | integer | no | Trade rows parsed from mapped statements. |
| rows_new | integer | no | Rows stored as revision 1. |
| rows_revised | integer | no | Rows stored as a later revision. |
| rows_unchanged | integer | no | Rows equal to the latest stored revision, not written. |

Primary key: (fetch_id)
